title: French Cuisine & Live Piano Concert at Chez Sandrine!
blurb:
Enter into an elegant and friendly home to enjoy delicate and delicious French cuisine from a true French artist! 

Sandrine studied music across France and enjoys sharing everything about French culture, including elegant French meals. You'll be welcomed into her home with a half hour piano concert. As food goes with music, cheese and wine will accompany the piano to start the culinary adventure.

• Learn about traditional French cuisine
• Live music performed by the chef herself
• Learn about French culture from a true local exctied to share her music and culture with you
•Enjoy a lot of wine and cheese
